description: The chart illustrates the popularity values for three knowledge domains (Movies, Songs, Basketball) across three models (Llama3, Qwen2, ChatGPT) and three outcome conditions indicated by bar fill patterns. The horizontal axis contains the categorical domains in left-to-right order “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball,” while the vertical axis is labeled “Popularity” and uses a linear numeric scale ranging from about 20 up to 220 with evenly spaced tick marks at approximately 20-unit intervals (e.g., 20, 60, 100, 140, 180, 220). Within each domain, bars are grouped by model color—Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in tan—and each model appears with three adjacent bars distinguished by patterns corresponding to the legend: dotted for “Acc=0 & GT Ans,” diagonal hatching for “Acc=0 & Gene Ans,” and solid fill for “Acc=1 & GT Ans.” For Movies, the Llama3 bars are approximately 25 (dotted), 35 (hatched), and 40 (solid); Qwen2 is about 28 (dotted), 40 (hatched), and 45 (solid); ChatGPT is about 26 (dotted), 30 (hatched), and 35 (solid). For Songs, Llama3 is about 58 (dotted), 50 (hatched), and 72 (solid); Qwen2 is about 58 (dotted), 65 (hatched), and 85 (solid); ChatGPT is about 45 (dotted), 55 (hatched), and 73 (solid). For Basketball, Llama3 is about 100 (dotted), 155 (hatched), and 178 (solid); Qwen2 is about 100 (dotted), 188 (hatched), and 210 (solid); ChatGPT is about 98 (dotted), 172 (hatched), and 138 (solid). The bars are not presented as a single sorted sequence across categories, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent use of color and hatch patterns described in the legend.
